description.text: The road itself is safe, but side turnings lead into rougher districts where thieves and footpads gather.

Its switchbacks zigzag up the steep lait that holds Kharbranth, linking the port at sea level with the Conclave at the top. The city is so steep and crowded that merchants sometimes hire porters rather than chull carts, and rich lighteyes are often carried along it in palanquins.
